info.title: Stream Recorder API
info.description: Versioned recorder contract. Existing /api endpoints remain compatible aliases; their collection and error shapes do not change. Browser-local theme is not shared server state.

put.description: Masked secret fields in responses never contain credentials. Omitted secrets retain their saved values.

post.description: Idempotency-Key is optional, 1–200 visible ASCII characters. Its caller-scoped mapping persists indefinitely, including after restart and recording deletion. A replay returns 201 with Idempotency-Replayed: true; a changed payload returns 409 idempotency_conflict. One active recording is allowed.

patch.description: Each field requires its matching permission; sending both requires both.

get.description: Returns a playable MP4 (binary) when state is ready. Protected by the same role/key policy as the recording.

201.description: Created; raw key shown once only

put.description: Raw PNG, JPEG, or WebP. Logos ≤2 MiB, ≤2048 px and ≤4 million pixels. Favicon ≤512 KiB and ≤512 px. Decoded and stored as PNG. SVG, animation and trailing active content are rejected without replacing the saved image. The SSO icon uses the logo limits.
